description: In the year to September 2026, domestic air fares rose 29.9% across India, against 3.8% for all travel fares (rail, road, air and water) (MoSPI's Consumer Price Index, provisional).

Rail fares rose 2.2%, taxi fares 3.3%, hotel rooms 2.4%, and a car or bus hired for a ceremony or a picnic 3.9%. The air fare rise was over thirteen times the rail fare rise. The map shows MoSPI's group 'Passenger transport services' by state. These are all-India prices for September 2026 against September 2025, not festival-week prices. MoSPI cautions that state-level indices may rest on thin samples of price quotations. September's figures are provisional and will be revised with October's release on 12 November.

done: Every figure is read from MoSPI's all-India item table (read 15 Oct 2026 and re-read 16 Oct: all 637 rows match) and tested by the builder; the name of every item code is checked, and any figure typed into a card must be one the story reads from a table.

Numbers editor (independent) re-read the items and 23 states of each closing map live at MoSPI: no mismatch. Viewer editor: the hook, title and top bar now give the period and 'provisional', so the figures are not read as festival-week prices.
Our own finding is tested: the air fare rise is 13.47 times the rail fare rise. Bus fares were left out: MoSPI's bus-and-coach figure covers commuting fares only.
